standard_prerequisites.name: Leray's acyclicity lemma and the relative Leray spectral sequence
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Derived Categories, the acyclicity lemma, and Cohomology on Sites, the relative Leray spectral sequence for the composite a_X = epsilon_X o pi_X
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the reduction from a complex to a single sheaf and the vanishing of the higher direct images of a_X.

core_obligations: Reduce to a single sheaf (proof lines 22780-22793): represent K by a bounded below complex of torsion abelian sheaves; the sheaf case gives F^n = a_{X,*}a_X^{-1}F^n with R^q a_{X,*}a_X^{-1}F^n = 0 for q > 0, so Leray's acyclicity lemma concludes; hence assume K = F a torsion sheaf.
Reformulate (proof lines 22795-22798): the h-description of the pullback gives a_{X,*}a_X^{-1}F = F, so it remains to prove the vanishing of R^q a_{X,*}a_X^{-1}F for q > 0.

Degenerate Leray (proof lines 22799-22807): write a_X = epsilon_X o pi_X and use the relative Leray spectral sequence; the V-C statement gives R^i epsilon_{X,*}(a_X^{-1}F) = 0 for i > 0 with epsilon_{X,*}a_X^{-1}F = pi_X^{-1}F, and the cohomological descent statement for the etale case gives R^j pi_{X,*}(pi_X^{-1}F) = 0 for j > 0; hence all higher direct images of a_X vanish.
proof_roadmap: Reduce a complex to a single torsion sheaf by Leray's acyclicity lemma.
Rewrite a_{X,*}a_X^{-1}F by the description of the pullback.
Degenerate the relative Leray spectral sequence with the two vanishing inputs.
difficulty_reason: The lemma establishes cohomological descent for the comparison between the h-topology and the small etale topos, for complexes with torsion cohomology sheaves (statement lines 22769-22777). The proof (proof lines 22779-22807) reduces to a single torsion sheaf by Leray's acyclicity lemma, rewrites the composite pushforward by the description of the pullback, and degenerates the relative Leray spectral sequence using the V-C statement and the etale cohomological descent. H2: one reduction plus one spectral sequence degeneration, written out.
